title: Lemma 7.1.4 (decomposition lemma) in the competitor form of Definition 7.1.1
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, A ⊆ ℝ^P, and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in A (Simon 7.1.1, IsMinimizingIn). Let T₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be such that T₁ and T − T₁ are integer multiplicity and, for every open W ⊂⊂ U, M_W(T₁) + M_W(T − T₁) ≤ M_W(T) and M_W(T − T₁) < ∞. Then T₁ is minimizing in A.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity (T - T₁) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T₁.massOn W + (T - T₁).massOn W ≤ T.massOn W) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → (T - T₁).massOn W ≠ ∞) → IsMinimizingIn T₁ A
